name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Card Holder With Money Tray
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, featuring a single wooden layer with 3mm thickness for a lightweight yet sturdy feel.
    - Smoothly cut and polished surface with a  wood finish.
    - Includes a clear plastic money tray designed to securely hold rolled cash.
    - Comes with 3 hanging strings (multiple color options) for flexible display styles.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wooden card size: 5 x 5 inches ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm.
    - Money tray size: 3.74 x 1.49 inches ~ 9.5 x 3.8 cm.
    - Designed in a custom shape with a pre-marked center area for tray attachment.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Installation Guide (Easy Assembly):
    - Peel off the protective backing from the adhesive on the money tray.
    - Press the tray firmly onto the center of the wooden card.
    - Remove the inner protective layer to expose the full adhesive area. 
    - Roll the bill and place it inside the clear tray, then press to secure.
    - Simple self-assembly by hand — no tools or glue needed.
    📌 Note: Money is not included.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality printing technology for clear, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Features double-sided printing, ensuring a polished look from both the front and back.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a wooden greeting card with a built-in money holder.
    - Perfect for gifting cash in a creative and memorable way.
    - Suitable for hanging or display in gift areas, celebration tables, or decorative spaces.
    - Combines functionality with décor, serving as both a gift card holder and a keepsake display.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and fun gift for moms, dads, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Ideal for Mother’s Day, birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - A unique keepsake that turns a simple cash gift into a meaningful surprise.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Card Holder With Money Tray

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
